acceptanceCriteriaVerified: Given the seeded environment, When an automated test accesses the site, Then all primary paths (canon links, podcast views, search) function correctly against the seeded Russian content
Given a public request, When targeting the external URL, Then the live site is accessible
Given E2E test execution, When interacting with UI, Then all views meet WCAG 2.1 AA compliance (keyboard operability, visible focus, labelled form controls, 4.5:1 text contrast)
notes: Automated E2E and unit test suites verified seeded Russian content paths, keyboard operability, and WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility.
